name: tpassist
description: Assistant IA local pour TD/TP/EI basé sur le Claude Agent SDK

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tpassist/server" "npm run dev -w @tpassist/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tpassist/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tpassist/server && npm run typecheck -w @tpassist/web
